_comment: guardian2 config template — copy to ~/.imp/guardian2.json, edit, then /guardian2 reload. deny rules block a bash command outright; ask rules prompt the human; anything unmatched runs (the default is allow). Patterns are JavaScript regex sources; flags may not contain g or y.

deny.reason: deleting under the home directory is never allowed — hand this to the human

ask.reason: running as root — do it as the normal user, or hand the privileged step to the human
force push rewrites shared history — push normally, or coordinate the rewrite first (--force-with-lease is the guarded variant)
